nodes.name: View dispatcher
nodes.responsibility: Measures, settles and paints one drawing, in that order

nodes.name: Measured text
nodes.responsibility: Wraps every card, note and label and measures what the SVG will paint

nodes.name: Compound layout
nodes.responsibility: Settles cards, frames, routes and labels as one drawing, and keeps a column fold only when it fits the pane better

nodes.name: Architecture painter
nodes.responsibility: Paints the settled drawing and decides no geometry of its own

nodes.name: Pretext
nodes.responsibility: Breaks a prepared string into lines at a given width

nodes.name: Host canvas
nodes.responsibility: The canvas of whatever draws the picture, with the diagram faces loaded

nodes.name: Compound graph
nodes.responsibility: States containment, measured sizes, authored order, relationship kinds and comparison standing as one graph

nodes.name: Layout engine
nodes.responsibility: Places, folds and routes one graph inside a layout worker

nodes.name: Column folds
nodes.responsibility: Names the column counts a settled drawing could fold into, and folds a placement into that many columns

nodes.name: Label reservations
nodes.responsibility: Reserves layout space for a label no run of its route can hold, and releases reservations a label no longer uses

nodes.name: Graphviz placement
nodes.responsibility: Places cards and frames with Graphviz's ranking across clusters, keeping containment

nodes.name: Obstacle routing
nodes.responsibility: Routes every relationship orthogonally around cards and unrelated frames, through shared ports per relationship kind

nodes.name: Graphviz
nodes.responsibility: Ranks a clustered graph and places its nodes

nodes.name: libavoid
nodes.responsibility: Routes orthogonal connectors around obstacle shapes
